title: Meeting Of University Professors And Staff Employees Federation

page_data.en:
June 15, 1936.

-4-

Visit to the Ming Foong Paper Mill

Approximately 400 Chinese, including representatives
of local industrial circles, public bodies and Chinese
authorities, left Shanghai North Railway Station for Kashing
at 9 a.m. June 14 at the invitation of the management of the
Ming Foong Paper Mill, Kashing, for the purpose of making a
tour of inspection.

Shanghai College and University Presidents' Association -
meeting

Twenty members of the Shanghai College and University
Presidents' Association, with a communication address in
the Chiaotung University, Avenue Haig, held a meeting at
6 p.m. June 13 in the Chinese Y.M.C.A., 123 Boulevard de
Montigny. Dr. Herman C.E.Liu presided. During the proceedings,
it was decided to promote a physical training association
in various colleges and universities. It was also decided
that the presidents of Chiaotung University, the University
of Shanghai, the Kwang Hwa University, the Great China
University, the Utopia University, the Fuh Tan University
and the Dong Chi University should form an executive committee
of the proposed association.

Shanghai Boyscouts Committee

The Shanghai Boyscouts Committee, 200 Dah Chih Road,
on June 14 issued instructions to local boyscout groups
that with effect from June 21 all scouts over the age of
16 are to assist in the construction of three roads at the
Civic Centre.
page_data.zh:
1936年6月15日。

-4-

参观明丰造纸厂

6月14日上午9时，应嘉兴明丰造纸厂管理层之邀，约400名华人（包括当地工业界代表、公共团体及中国当局代表）离开上海北站前往嘉兴，进行视察参观。

上海大专院校校长协会——会议

上海大专院校校长协会20名成员（通讯地址为海格路交通大学）于6月13日下午6时在蒙梯尼路123号中华基督教青年会举行会议。刘恩荣博士主持。会议期间，决定在各大专院校推广体育训练协会。还决定由交通大学、沪江大学、光华大学、大夏大学、大同大学、复旦大学和同济大学的校长组成该拟议协会的执行委员会。

上海童子军委员会

位于大智路200号的上海童子军委员会于6月14日向本地童子军团发布指令，规定自6月21日起，所有16岁以上的童子军须协助市中心区域三条道路的建设工作。

University Professors & Staff Employees' Federation - meeting
500 members of the University Professors & Staff
Employees' Federation held a general meeting at 2.30 p.m.
June 7 in their office, 45 Rue Victor Emmanuel. During the
proceedings, it was decided to despatch a telegram to the
National Government requesting the immediate suppression
of smuggling in the North and protesting against the
increase of Japanese troops in North China.

大学教授及职员联合会——会议
大学教授及职员联合会500名成员于6月7日下午2时30分在该会办公室（维克多·艾曼纽尔路45号）举行全体会议。会议期间，决定向国民政府发出电报，要求立即取缔华北走私活动，并抗议日军在华北增兵。

April 2, 1935.

Political (3)

D 5478
University Professors' and Teaching Staff Federation
- meeting

Five committee members of the University Professors
and Teaching Staff Federation held a meeting in their
office, 45 Route Victor Emmanuel III, between 5 p.m. and
6 p.m. March 31 and passed the following resolutions :-

1. That with a view to promoting the education movement
among adults the following measures be adopted :-

a) That a manifesto be issued.

b) That in conjunction with various public bodies
in the Settlement and French Concession, a
"Shanghai Municipality Special District Adults'
Supplementary Education Acceleration Society"
be formed.

2. That the next committee meeting of the federation be
convened at 2 p.m. April 21, in the Medium Club,
674 Weihaiwei Road.

Various Movements to be Promoted by the Local Kuomintang

The Shanghai District Kuomintang has received an order
from the Central Kuomintang instructing that the following
activities be supported by all members:-

1) Education promotion.
2) Public sanitation.
3) Reafforestation.
4) Highway construction.
5) Cooperation movement.
6) Relief scheme for the poor.
7) New Life Movement.
8) Opium suppression.
9) Village self-protection movement.
10) Thrift movement.
11) Health movement.
12) Social education.
13) Aviation movement.

政治类 (3)

D 5478
大学教授及教职员联合会——会议

大学教授及教职员联合会的五名委员于3月31日下午5时至6时之间，在该会办公室（维克多·艾曼纽尔三世路45号）举行会议，并通过以下决议：-

1. 为促进成人教育运动，采取以下措施：-

a) 发表宣言。

b) 与公共租界及法租界各公共团体联合，成立“上海市特区成人补习教育促进会”。

2. 联合会下一次委员会议定于4月21日下午2时在威海卫路674号中型俱乐部召开。

本地国民党拟推动的各项运动

上海区国民党接到中央国民党命令，指示全体党员支持以下活动：-

1) 教育推广。
2) 公共卫生。
3) 重新造林。
4) 公路建设。
5) 合作运动。
6) 贫民救济计划。
7) 新生活运动。
8) 禁烟。
9) 乡村自卫运动。
10) 节俭运动。
11) 卫生运动。
12) 社会教育。
13) 航空运动。

page_data.en:
April 2, 1935.
Political (4)
The Education Movement will be undertaken first.
As from May 1, every educated member of the local Kuomintang
will be required to teach two illiterate persons to read
and write Chinese within a period of two months.
Yesterday the Shanghai District Kuomintang
notified the members to the above effect.
page_data.zh:
1935年4月2日。
政治类 (4)
教育运动将率先开展。
自5月1日起，本地国民党每名受过教育的党员须在两个月内教会两名文盲读写中文。
昨日，上海区国民党已就此通知各党员。

August 6-7,1934.

POLITICAL

SHANGHAI VARIOUS UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS AND STAFF EMPLOYEES
FEDERATION - MEETING RE EDUCATIONAL RIGHTS IN SETTLEMENT.

Eight committee members of the above mentioned
Federation held a meeting in their office, 45 Victor
Emmanuel, at 8 a.m. August 5. The request of the
Shanghai Educational Association for cooperation of the
Federation in the movement to recover educational rights
in the Settlement was discussed and it was decided that
a letter be despatched informing the Association of the
willingness of the Fed ration to comply.

上海各大学教授及职员联合会——关于租界教育权问题的会议

上述联合会八名委员于8月5日上午8时在该会办公室（维克多·艾曼纽尔路45号）举行会议。会议讨论了上海教育协会请求该会在收回租界教育权运动中予以合作的提议，并决定去函告知该会，联合会愿意配合。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGT. File No. D No. S. 14. XXXX / Date November 20, 1933.）

Subject (in full) University Professors Association.

Made by D.I. Sih Tse Liang Forwarded by W Duncan AND

Fifteen members of the Committee of the
University Professors' Association held a meeting
in the Chinese Y.M.C.A. building, 123 boulevard de
Montigny, at 2 p.m. November 19, and passed the
following resolutions:-

1. That the Ministry of Education be requested to
assign a certain sum out of Boxer Indemnity for
use of Chinese professors in going abroad for
a tour of inspection.

2. That all staff members be instructed to conclude
all pending matters without further delay.

The meeting terminated at 3.15 p.m.

The foregoing information was obtained by Agent 58.

Sih Tse Liang
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别处登记处。档案编号 D 编号 S. 14. XXXX / 日期：1933年11月20日。）

主题（全称）：大学教授协会。

呈报人：巡官 施子良 转呈人 W Duncan 及

大学教授协会委员会十五名成员于11月19日下午2时在蒙梯尼路123号中华基督教青年会大楼举行会议，并通过以下决议：-

1. 请求教育部从庚子赔款中拨出一定款项，供中国教授出国考察之用。

2. 指示全体职员立即结束所有待决事项，不得再行拖延。

会议于下午3时15分结束。

上述情报由58号探员获取。

施子良
巡官

特别处主管警官。

（批注：归档 M）
